title: Require Domain Module Contract Aggregate Shape
forbids: semantic-module contract files exposing operation contracts or any authority besides their singular default defineDomainSubdomain result
why: A semantic module contract is one aggregate identity over its operation registry. Keeping constituent contracts private preserves one contract authority while leaving execution to the router.
remediate: Import the default ./ops/contract.js registry, compose one local defineDomainSubdomain binding, and export only that binding as default.
message: Domain module contract.ts must expose one default aggregate contract authority only.
